_comment: Attack catalogue for the Cross-Layer IDS evaluation console. Each entry is a FIXED command launched by id; the console never runs arbitrary text from the browser. Placeholders {pkg} {cmd_topic} {auth_topic} {drive_topic} {robot_ip} {iface} {rtps_port} are filled from console config. 'layer' is the detector layer EXPECTED to catch it, used to score the cross-layer evaluation. LAB USE ONLY: every command targets the operator's own robot on an isolated ROS_DOMAIN_ID.

attacks.label: Floor it (forward)
attacks.cmd: ros2 topic pub -r 100 {cmd_topic} geometry_msgs/msg/Twist "{linear: {x: 2.5, y: 0.0, z: 0.0}, angular: {z: 0.0}}"
attacks.desc: Publish max-speed forward 5x faster than the real controller. Infeasible step -> feasibility check.

attacks.label: Slam reverse
attacks.cmd: ros2 topic pub -r 100 {cmd_topic} geometry_msgs/msg/Twist "{linear: {x: -2.0, y: 0.0, z: 0.0}, angular: {z: 0.0}}"
attacks.desc: Sudden full reverse; large velocity jump.

attacks.label: Hard spin left
attacks.desc: Max angular rate; exceeds w_max.

attacks.label: Hard spin right
attacks.desc: Max angular rate, opposite sign.

attacks.label: Freeze (deny motion)
attacks.desc: Flood zeros so the robot stops although commanded to move: consistency residual.

attacks.label: NaN garbage
attacks.desc: Non-finite values; caught by the finiteness check.

attacks.label: Out-of-range value
attacks.desc: Absurd magnitude; feasibility envelope.

attacks.label: Stealth drift (+0.10 m/s)
attacks.desc: Small feasible bias on top of the real command; only the CUSUM catches it over time.

attacks.label: Hijack steering
attacks.desc: Feasible steering bias that drives the robot off the track.

attacks.label: Crude takeover
attacks.desc: Large infeasible add-on to the real command.

attacks.label: Oscillation (shake)
attacks.cmd: bash -c 'while true; do ros2 topic pub -1 {cmd_topic} geometry_msgs/msg/Twist "{angular: {z: 3.0}}"; sleep 0.15; ros2 topic pub -1 {cmd_topic} geometry_msgs/msg/Twist "{angular: {z: -3.0}}"; sleep 0.15; done'
attacks.desc: Rapidly alternating turn commands; destabilising.

attacks.label: Node-name spoof (as pure_pursuit)
attacks.desc: Attacker takes the legitimate node's name -> network allowlist fooled; only physics + the two-writer wire check see it.

attacks.label: Topic squat (publish to /cmd_vel)
attacks.desc: Bypass the raw topic and write straight to the robot's final command topic.

attacks.label: Eavesdrop auth stream
attacks.desc: Passive subscription to the authorized commands. A confidentiality attack the IDS does NOT catch - an honest limitation to show.

attacks.label: Tamper controller speed param
attacks.desc: Change the legitimate controller's own parameter via the unauthenticated param service.

attacks.label: High-rate publisher takeover
attacks.desc: Overwhelm the wire at 500 Hz so the attacker's command always wins the race.

attacks.label: Participant flood
attacks.desc: Rapidly create/destroy participants: discovery-plane DoS. Robot keeps driving normally -> network layer only.

attacks.label: Endpoint churn
attacks.cmd: bash -c 'while true; do ros2 topic pub -1 /junk_$RANDOM std_msgs/msg/String "{data: x}"; done'
attacks.desc: Flood of short-lived writers: SEDP endpoint churn.

attacks.label: DDS port scan
attacks.desc: Scan the domain-42 RTPS UDP port range on the robot host.

attacks.label: Discovery multicast probe
attacks.desc: Probe the SPDP multicast address.

attacks.label: UDP flood at RTPS port
attacks.desc: Volumetric UDP flood at the user-data port. Needs sudo. LAB ONLY.

attacks.label: Bandwidth saturation
attacks.desc: Saturate the link with UDP traffic (needs 'iperf3 -s' running on the robot host).

attacks.label: Host recon scan
attacks.desc: Discover live hosts on the lab subnet.

attacks.label: Inject 200 ms latency
attacks.cmd: sudo tc qdisc add dev {iface} root netem delay 200ms
attacks.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST. Adds delay to its outbound traffic. Remove with the cleanup button.

attacks.label: Inject 20% packet loss
attacks.cmd: sudo tc qdisc add dev {iface} root netem loss 20%
attacks.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST. Drops 20% of outbound packets.

attacks.label: Inject jitter
attacks.cmd: sudo tc qdisc add dev {iface} root netem delay 100ms 50ms
attacks.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST. 100 ms +/- 50 ms jitter.

tools.label: Wire capture (tshark)
tools.desc: Live DDS metrics and the two-writer / flood alerts.

tools.label: iperf3 server (on robot host)
tools.desc: RUN ON THE ROBOT HOST so the saturation attack has a target.

tools.label: Latency baseline (ping)
tools.desc: Round-trip time to the robot host.

tools.label: Clear tc netem (robot host)
tools.cmd: sudo tc qdisc del dev {iface} root
